label: Cursor — Promax superset (standalone host pack)
description: Guards, routing and preflight run from the bundled host pack — no checkout, no Docker

beforeSubmitPrompt.command: bash -lc 'export HARNESS_TREE=cursor; exec node .harness/host-pack/harness-hook.mjs --hook preflight --tree cursor'
bash -lc 'export HARNESS_TREE=cursor; exec node .harness/host-pack/harness-hook.mjs --hook route --tree cursor'

beforeShellExecution.command: bash -lc 'export HARNESS_TREE=cursor; exec node .harness/host-pack/harness-hook.mjs --hook guard-shell --tree cursor'

afterFileEdit.command: bash -lc 'export HARNESS_TREE=cursor; exec node .harness/host-pack/harness-hook.mjs --hook route --tree cursor'

preToolUse.command: bash -lc 'export HARNESS_TREE=cursor; exec node .harness/host-pack/harness-hook.mjs --hook guard-brain --tree cursor'

preCompact.command: bash -lc 'export HARNESS_TREE=cursor; exec node .harness/host-pack/harness-hook.mjs --hook pre-compact --tree cursor'

postToolUse.command: bash -lc 'export HARNESS_TREE=cursor; exec node .harness/host-pack/harness-hook.mjs --hook gap-tracker --tree cursor'
bash -lc 'export HARNESS_TREE=cursor; exec node .harness/host-pack/harness-hook.mjs --hook post-tool-hint --tree cursor'
bash -lc 'export HARNESS_TREE=cursor; exec node .harness/host-pack/harness-hook.mjs --hook route --tree cursor'

stop.command: bash -lc 'export HARNESS_TREE=cursor; exec node .harness/host-pack/harness-hook.mjs --hook route --tree cursor'
